items.text: Fixed distance calculations to use true 2‑D magnitude, restoring accurate weapon range checks, detection, and building interactions.
Turrets under remote control can now damage reactive targets.
Machetes and swords now run on a dedicated subsystem and an unused override controller was removed, improving weapon handling stability.
Triangle foundations no longer merge buildings when only touching at a corner, preventing accidental structure connections.
Sandbag pillbox collider import settings restored, re‑enabling proper collision and physics for sandbag structures.
Sandbag barricade variants cost 50 stone and 5 cloth (down from 100/10) and build in 10 seconds (down from 30), speeding up fortifications.
Neon signs now offer a colour wheel and a larger 25 mm size option, expanding signage customization.
All vehicles now include a universal “Swap Seats” action with a consistent button binding.
Added a car reload action and removed the old menu‑gesture action, streamlining vehicle interaction.
The duck toggle now works correctly on non‑modular cars.
Biofuel generators now mount the player while stirring, automatically unmount on release, and show a “no electricity” status when stirred without power.
Navmesh generation on fences restored and rustNavmeshVolumes re‑enabled, improving AI and livestock pathing.
Livestock now spread out at troughs instead of forming a line, enhancing avoidance behavior.

items.text: Fixed gender assignment when purchasing animals.

Sheep now drop wool when sheared; introduced a wool item that stacks to 100 and can be sold to the stables vendor via the auction system, with tiered rewards based on total wool (up to 1000) and a three‑strike rejection limit that locks the vendor for 15 minutes.

Implemented an animal‑trading auction: players receive three item bundles per sale, can reject bundles a limited number of times before the vendor becomes unavailable; vendor UI now only shows animals following the speaking player, annoyance is tied to the animal, and auction results wait for dialogue to finish.

AI improvements for livestock and critters: cows avoid clipping and can eat from blocked troughs, bear flee logic corrected, critters startle and flee when players approach (no longer startle each other), sight ranges reduced, and legacy animal states simplified.
Adjusted loot tables for the Trainyard, Water Treatment, and Sewer power‑level rooms.
Improved C4 client prediction, fixed rotation blending over its full range, and refined hide/show event handling for more reliable C4 behavior.
Added a new oil‑rig switch event to the monument system and introduced extra air‑drop and satellite selection events.

Overhauled sandbag stacking and upgrades: only the default sandbag is craftable, upgrade cooldowns fixed, health retention during upgrades configurable, placement checks tightened to prevent clipping, and upgrade visuals improved.
Expanded the sell table with several guns for testing purposes.
Fixed country selection UI bugs: automatic rows now match country rows and auto‑detect works reliably, preventing mismatched selections.
Remote players now rotate fully instead of snapping to the shortest turn, improving combat visual consistency.
Server can now toggle god mode via ServerSetGod, fixing tutorial god‑mode disabling and allowing server‑side control.
Added extra placement checks for sandbag and barricade stacking, preventing invalid builds and ensuring proper placement.
Upgrade placement now hides the existing mesh and shows only the placement guide, reducing visual clutter during building upgrades.
Introduces a revamped country selection interface with continent grouping and tab‑based navigation.
Livestock now more reliably avoid water, reducing accidental drowning and improving herd movement.
Animals gain water‑avoidance preferences in roaming and fleeing behaviors, making them less likely to enter water hazards.

2026-09-16.summary:
### Livestock & Animals
- Fixed gender assignment when purchasing animals.
- Sheep now drop wool when sheared; introduced a wool item that stacks to 100 and can be sold to the stables vendor via the auction system, with tiered rewards based on total wool (up to 1000) and a three‑strike rejection limit that locks the vendor for 15 minutes.
- Implemented an animal‑trading auction: players receive three item bundles per sale, can reject bundles a limited number of times before the vendor becomes unavailable; vendor UI now only shows animals following the speaking player, annoyance is tied to the animal, and auction results wait for dialogue to finish.
- AI improvements for livestock and critters: cows avoid clipping and can eat from blocked troughs, bear flee logic corrected, critters startle and flee when players approach (no longer startle each other), sight ranges reduced, and legacy animal states simplified.

### Powerlevel Loot Tweaks
- Adjusted loot tables for the Trainyard, Water Treatment, and Sewer power‑level rooms.

### Combat & Explosives
- Improved C4 client prediction, fixed rotation blending over its full range, and refined hide/show event handling for more reliable C4 behavior.

### World Events & Monuments
- Added a new oil‑rig switch event to the monument system and introduced extra air‑drop and satellite selection events.

### Structures & Crafting
- Overhauled sandbag stacking and upgrades: only the default sandbag is craftable, upgrade cooldowns fixed, health retention during upgrades configurable, placement checks tightened to prevent clipping, and upgrade visuals improved.

### Economy & Trading
- Expanded the sell table with several guns for testing purposes.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed country selection UI bugs: automatic rows now match country rows and auto‑detect works reliably, preventing mismatched selections.
- Remote players now rotate fully instead of snapping to the shortest turn, improving combat visual consistency.
- Server can now toggle god mode via ServerSetGod, fixing tutorial god‑mode disabling and allowing server‑side control.
- Added extra placement checks for sandbag and barricade stacking, preventing invalid builds and ensuring proper placement.
- Upgrade placement now hides the existing mesh and shows only the placement guide, reducing visual clutter during building upgrades.
- Introduces a revamped country selection interface with continent grouping and tab‑based navigation.
- Livestock now more reliably avoid water, reducing accidental drowning and improving herd movement.
- Animals gain water‑avoidance preferences in roaming and fleeing behaviors, making them less likely to enter water hazards.

items.text: Creamy and milky tea variants adjust healing effectiveness and duration (e.g., creamy healing tea 97 HP/20 s, milky healing tea 112 HP/45 s).
Milk can be processed after 4 hours in a refrigerated container to produce skimmed milk (½ calories, 80 % hydration, ½ health) and cream (½ calories, 20 % hydration, +50 % health).
Apples now have a 10 % chance to survive if the tree is harvested before fruit is picked, and fruit no longer falls when a tree is hit.
Apartment complexes are flagged as safe zones and placement restrictions near them now correctly warn when too close.
Critters remain active throughout the night, and rabbits no longer react to nearby items, reducing server load.
Turtle spawning issues have been resolved, ensuring turtles appear in the world as intended.
Sheep now correctly mark attackers as hostile, walk, attack players, and die as expected.

UI improvements: background tile sprite restored, server browser filter works correctly, player count display remains stable when switching gamemodes, and market terminals show a "No Power" message when unpowered.
Alt + Mouse wheel now provides fine‑grained zoom control.
Store UI now falls back to the first completed image request if the HTTP image delay expires, reducing missing images.
Added a new bind command for gamepad defaults and fixed reset behavior when no keyboard/mouse is bound.
Added explosive setup to certain weapons, enabling explosive damage.
Fixed beef spoil item assignment, ensuring proper food spoilage.
Fences no longer sink into terrain, can be placed on slopes and angled up to 20°, improving building precision.
Ladder hatches are now skinnable and feature open/close functionality for workshop use.
Hazmat suits now include the missing component, restoring intended protection levels.
